## Validation and limitations

Seven records screened during development were all retrieved: **100% relative recall against the development set**. This is not independent validation or sensitivity; there were no user-supplied seeds, held-out records, or matching-review benchmark.

The optional school-setting and food-consumption blocks each retained all known records and had 0 relevant records in their refreshed 30-record loss samples. Category probes found wording gaps, which were addressed, but the standard probe budget was exhausted: education coverage remains uncertain after a later population-block change, and the population probe’s estimated residual risk was not checked with another sample. One likely relevant fifth-grade record has no abstract and remains provisional.

The internal PRESS-structured critic passed with no technical blockers, but it used the same context. **Human PRESS peer review by an information specialist is still needed before use.**
